eval_command: PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m ppo_experiment.evaluate --weights weights/ppo_allocation_train101.zip weights/ppo_allocation_train102.zip --eval-seeds 901 902 903 904 --outdir reports
eval_note: Heldout seeds 901-904 are disjoint from train scenario seeds 101-102. OR-Tools and nearest solve the identical Scenario bundle one-shot through optimization.solver.optimize. PPO rolls out sequentially with deterministic actions. Seed 901 OR-Tools wall time includes first-call optimizer import. PPO underperforms on seed 902 and matches OR-Tools on 901, 903, 904; reported as measured.
train_command: PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m ppo_experiment.train --seed {101,102} --timesteps 8192 --outdir weights
